description:
The pull-drive machinery was copy-pasted rather than shared, introducing untracked duplication (CLAUDE.md: scaffolding/debt added on the fly must be ticketed).

DUPLICATES
- Two near-identical pull-drive loops: compiler.rs:163 (product_backend_program_for_root, returns in-memory BackendProgram, String errors) vs jobs/backend.rs:45 (build_backend_product, publishes the BackendProgram fact, FatalError).
- Five helpers duplicated verbatim between compiler.rs and jobs/backend.rs: drive_product_fact_wait, demand_product_fact_producer, demand_if_needed, product_fact_wait_is_satisfied, forbidden_product_path_job.
- forbidden_product_path_job has two MORE copies in transport_contract_test.rs (4902, 4919). The lists can already drift between sites.

GOAL
One shared pull-drive runner + one shared fact-wait helper kit (parameterized over the error type / whether to publish a fact), consumed by both the interp front door and the BuildBackendProduct job. One definition of forbidden_product_path_job (or, after fz-go4.18.4 deletes the legacy spine, none at all).

NOTE
Sequence with fz-go4.18.4: if the legacy spine is deleted first, forbidden_product_path_job and much of the fact-wait poking may disappear entirely, shrinking what needs deduping. Prefer doing this after the epic, or coordinate.

comments.text: ENRICHED by the .18.19 removable-code audit (2026-07-02): the duplication is worse than filed — backend.rs:149-200 and compiler.rs:336-385 are a byte-for-byte copy-paste pair (demand_product_fact_producer + demand_if_needed + product_fact_wait_is_satisfied + the twin 50_000-budget drive loops at backend.rs:89-146 / compiler.rs:279-333), AND demand_if_needed's guard (output_keys contains target && !rebased) is now a THIRD variant of the 'standing producer, don't re-run' predicate alongside Scheduler::conclusion_stands (scheduler.rs:250-252) and the agenda dedupe. Unification should consider a single coalescing World::demand seam — but semantics differ subtly (fact-targeted vs job-level; the poke-loop 'no ready producer' error path), so not a mechanical fold. NOTE: fz-go4.18.4's deletion already removed forbidden_product_path_job; re-verify remaining scope vs HEAD before implementing.

title: Dedup the pull-drive loop and shared fact-wait helpers across compiler.rs and jobs/backend.rs
